Q002.question: Summarize the business initiative, problem or opportunity, proposed solution, and intended outcome as explicitly described in the source documents.

answer.summary: The initiative is a proof‑of‑concept using a pre‑filled Business Requirements Specification (BRS) to demonstrate extraction of business requirements, generation of a Detailed Requirement Specification (DRS), creation of user stories and acceptance criteria, and traceability from business objectives to implementation‑ready backlog items. The problem is that the current loan processing workflow requires duplicate data entry, manual exchange of financial statements and documents via email or shared folders, analysts spending time chasing missing information, separate tracking of risk and credit approvals, manual follow‑up of approval conditions, and an inability to reliably identify applications approaching their processing SLA. The proposed solution is to extract and generate these requirement artifacts as described, establishing traceability to implementation‑ready backlog items. The intended outcome is a set of automated artifacts (DRS, user stories, acceptance criteria) and traceable backlog items that address the identified limitations.

Q003.question: Extract a dedicated business background mentioned in the given document . If no dedicated business background or current business context is explicitly stated in the source documents, return null.

answer.background:
The organization currently processes corporate and institutional loan requests through email, spreadsheets and manual credit work queues. Relationship Managers collect borrower information and financial documents, after which Operations, Credit, Risk, Compliance and Loan Administration perform separate checks before a facility can be approved and set up. Information is repeatedly keyed into downstream records.
A typical loan request takes twelve business days from initial submission to facility setup. Delays are concentrated around incomplete borrower packs, financial spreading, credit review, risk approval and follow-up on approval conditions. Management has limited real-time visibility of where an application is waiting.

Q017.question: Extract all explicitly stated business rules

answer.rule_statement: All mandatory borrower and credit documents must be present before credit review can be completed.
A High Risk loan requires Risk Manager approval in addition to the applicable Credit approval.
An application with missing mandatory information shall be placed on hold and returned to the requestor.
Every approval, rejection, return and conditional approval shall include timestamp, decision-maker identity and decision details.
Loan facility setup shall not begin until required Credit, Risk and Compliance approvals are recorded and mandatory conditions are satisfied.
A rejection shall require a reason and shall close the active workflow unless reopened by an authorized role.
Only authorized users may view or download borrower financial and collateral documents.
Overdue credit and approval tasks shall trigger reminders according to the configured SLA schedule.
